# Backtest Replay and CandleKit Integration Checklist: Backtest Candle Replay

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, and consistency of requirements for Backtest replay, chart synchronization, drawing state, and CandleKit integration.
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## CandleKit and Drawing Requirement Coverage

- [x] CHK001 Is the user-mandated CandleKit choice recorded as a required architecture constraint, while the user-visible feature outcomes remain in the specification? [Spec §FR-021–FR-030; Plan §Summary; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK002 Are CandleKit's required React components and replay, synchronization, and drawing engines distinguished from JanusEdge's authority for run data and persistence of the shared cursor and user-scoped drawing documents? [Plan §Summary; Plan §Architecture and Data Flow]
- [x] CHK003 Does the requirement define observable criteria for styling CandleKit's charts, controls, and overlays to match JanusEdge, including the existing light/dark theme behavior? [Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK004 Does the specification define the v1 standard drawing tool set and create, select, reposition, edit, and remove actions, with the CandleKit tool mapping captured in the plan? [Spec §US5; Spec §FR-028; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK005 Are drawing save, restore, edit, and deletion expectations specified, including their user, run, and timeframe scope and behavior after navigation or reload? [Spec §US5; Spec §FR-029; Plan §Design Decisions; Plan §Architecture and Data Flow]
- [x] CHK006 Does the requirement explain drawing visibility when the replay cursor moves backward, including whether visibility uses replay-aware CandleKit behavior or falls back to anchor time? [Spec §FR-030; Plan §Design Decisions; Research §6]
  - Finding: The user chose to preserve replay-aware visibility if the pinned CandleKit artifact provides it; otherwise v1 filters by time anchor only and does not track creation/edit time. This does not prevent later-created, past-anchored drawings from appearing after rewind; the user accepted this v1 trade-off.
- [x] CHK007 Are drawing visibility and reuse across chart tabs with different timeframes explicitly defined, including whether drawings are shared, transformed, or kept timeframe-specific? [Spec §US5; Spec §FR-029; Plan §Design Decisions]

## Clarity and Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Does the one-year date-range limit define its calendar meaning at timezone and leap-year boundaries, consistently across date selection, validation, and the accepted run range? [Spec §FR-004; Spec §FR-023; Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK009 Do the no-data and failure requirements explain how users can read the outcome and take the stated next action when the run and account are immediately deleted? [Spec §FR-017; Spec §FR-022; Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK010 Does the preparing-run requirement define what progress communicates (for example, a meaningful stage or determinate measure) while remaining consistent with the retry behavior? [Spec §FR-017; Spec §FR-018; Spec §FR-022; Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK011 Do data-gap requirements distinguish dates with no candles from missing intervals within an otherwise populated date, and specify what gap information users should receive? [Spec §FR-005; Spec §FR-007; Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK012 Does the chart-interval requirement make clear how standard and custom intervals coexist, how invalid custom values are handled, and whether interval selection is retained per tab? [Spec §FR-023; Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK013 Do crosshair requirements define time alignment across intervals when a target chart has no candle at the exact source timestamp, and is pan/zoom behavior explicit as pane-local? [Spec §FR-026; Spec §FR-027; Spec §SC-012]
- [x] CHK014 Are replay position, visible chart data, and active higher-timeframe bar requirements consistent for seek, step-back, gaps, and interval boundaries, including the no-look-ahead constraint? [Spec §FR-011; Spec §FR-013; Spec §FR-014; Spec §FR-024; Spec §SC-010]

## Scenario and Acceptance Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Do the user scenarios include acceptance outcomes for creating, editing, restoring, and removing drawings, including a return to the run after reload? [Spec §US5; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK016 Do acceptance scenarios cover a partially populated date range and make the expected gap report distinct from whole-range no-data cleanup and provider failure? [Spec §US2; Spec §FR-005; Spec §FR-007; Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK017 Do multi-tab scenarios state the expected shared replay/crosshair behavior and pane-local pan/zoom outcome at differing timeframes? [Spec §US3; Spec §FR-025; Spec §FR-027; Spec §SC-011; Spec §SC-012]

## Dependencies, Security, and Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK018 Are the CandleKit capabilities required from the selected release explicit, and is any acceptable fallback defined if the pinned package artifact lacks a documented React, replay, sync, or drawing API? [Plan §Technical Context; Plan §Design Decisions; Research §2; Research §Implementation-Time Validations]
- [x] CHK019 Do the requirements define user ownership and isolation for replay snapshots, cursor state, and drawings as clearly as they define separation between Real and Backtest activity? [Spec §FR-001; Spec §FR-008; Spec §FR-020; Plan §Constitution Check; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK020 Is there a measurable responsiveness or capacity expectation for replaying the maximum one-year dataset at 20x with multiple chart tabs, or an explicit decision that no separate performance target is required? [Spec §FR-012; Spec §FR-025; Plan §Technical Context]
  - Finding: The user chose no fixed tab maximum and no additional chart-tab capacity or rendering-performance target for v1. The existing 1x/5x/20x playback-rate requirement remains; no separate responsiveness guarantee is specified for an unbounded number of tabs.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
